slides.title: Key Concepts
slides.raw:
Key Concepts
Event-Driven Execution
Automatic Scaling
Pay-as-You-Go Billing Model
Stateless Functions
No Server Management
slides.teach: These points define the technology. Be able to explain each one in your own words and recognize it in a scenario.

course.learn: This section focuses on **Key Concepts** within **Serverless**. Serverless computing lets developers run functions or managed application logic without administering traditional servers directly. The provider manages much of the underlying runtime infrastructure.
course.why: The attack surface shifts rather than disappears: identity, function permissions, APIs, dependencies, secrets, and event inputs still need protection.
course.example: A function processes uploaded images when a storage event occurs and has permission only to read that bucket and write results.
course.exam: Serverless ≠ no servers and ≠ no security responsibility. Focus on least-privilege function roles, dependencies, API security, and secret handling.
